messages:
Miriam: handing off from night shift — quick summary of the embeddings autoscaler incident (02:10 UTC).
- What happened: autoscaler started oscillating under short burst load after a cold-cache regen; several replica churn events caused transient 503s for batch embeddings.
- Impact: ~8–12m of elevated 503s for some customers (support count: 4 tickets; one enterprise: AtlasSearch flagged).
- Mitigation applied: disabled autoscaler, manually scaled to 6 replica pods, increased request timeout for embedding worker to 20s, prefix KV cache regen rate-limited.

Devin: thanks — current health?

Miriam: services stable. p95 tokens for embeddings back to baseline (~120ms). Error rate has dropped to normal. Logging shows the churn window 02:08–02:20 UTC. We still need artifact (heap/dump) + aggregated autoscaler decision log to confirm root cause.

incident-bot: Pager resolved automatically (alerts suppressed). Incident created: INC-2026-042. Links: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-042

Sam: do we have runbook/run commands to hand over for the daytime crew?

Miriam: runbook pointers and quick commands:
- Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler
- Grafana dashboards: Grafana -> Embeddings / Autoscaler events / Embeddings latency
- Quick ops commands (kube context = cluster-east):
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings
kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=6
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embeddings-autoscaler --since=2h
```
- Check autoscaler decision logs: s3://redwood-ops/decisions/autoscaler/2026/03/09

Devin: customer comms status?

Miriam: Support sent an interim note to AtlasSearch and the other 3 customers apologizing + mitigation steps. We'll draft a short post-incident note after we confirm root cause. No SLA credits pending yet; tracking in INC-2026-042.

Sam: who is primary/secondary for the next 6 hours?

Miriam: assigning -> Primary: Sam (cover until 10:00 UTC), Secondary: Devin. I'm on watch for comms until handoff done.

Miriam: next steps / owners:
1) Sam: run controlled scale test at 04:30 UTC (scale up/down with load probe) and post results here. Command to run test is in runbook.
2) Devin: collect heap + autoscaler decision logs and upload to the incident S3 path, attach to INC-2026-042.
3) Miriam: draft customer-facing summary after logs are checked.
4) Keep autoscaler disabled until 06:00 UTC unless test proves stable — if re-enabled, enable gradual scale policy (max 1 replica per 2m).

Devin: noted. I'll pull logs and heap dumps now, will upload to the incident bucket and link back.

Sam: ack — will run the test at 04:30 and paste the results. If anything spikes, I'll escalate and revert to manual scaling. :white_check_mark:

Miriam: thanks team — leaving this thread open for the test results. If primary needs to hand off earlier, update participants here and ping @devin for backup. Runbook link again: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler

Sam: quick note for followups — suggested postmortem checklist: timeline, autoscaler metrics, pod churn events, config diff (autoscaler v2 -> v2.1), customer impact table. I'll start the timeline doc after the test.

Miriam: perfect. handing over now. Miriam signing off for night.
